title: LEFT JOIN and RIGHT JOIN
description: Use outer joins to include unmatched rows.

data.text: LEFT JOIN returns all rows from the left table and matched rows from the right table. RIGHT JOIN does the opposite.

data.title: Left Join
data.code:
SELECT u.id, u.email, o.id AS order_id
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY u.id
LIMIT 100;

data.title: NULL Extension
data.text: Unmatched right-side columns are NULL in an outer join.

data.title: Exercise: Users Without Orders
data.description: Find users with no orders using LEFT JOIN.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use LEFT JOIN to include unmatched left rows.
Use RIGHT JOIN rarely; prefer LEFT JOIN.
Check for NULL to find unmatched rows.
